section_summary.extract_value: This section describes a single study (Study X) that validated the Standard Chinese translation of the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS-2) in Hong Kong. The study included 345 participants (191 women, 154 men) from mainland China. It found the BAS-2 had a one-dimensional factor structure, good internal consistency, and correlations with self-esteem and life satisfaction, and with BMI in women.
